reviewed_keep_candidates.finding: The refined keep bucket still contained unsupported treatment, individualized advice, broken text, and question-answer mismatch cases.

reviewed_repair_routes.finding: Topic routing frequently linked a natural question to a source that could not support the requested fact.

clear_mismatch_examples.question: 进行性肌营养不良症的分类是什么?
乳腺增生可以吃鸽子吗?
更年期白带增多正常吗
排便发现蛔虫并自行服用阿苯达唑片
clear_mismatch_examples.wrong_keep_decision: specific drug and dose advice was not routed to repair

failure_reasons: direct keep candidates were not safety-clean
repair routing was not evidence-specific enough to trust without a redesigned matcher
the repair workload exceeded the pilot budget

recommendation.rationale: Reuse the frozen evidence-reviewed API set and deterministic general subset instead of investing in a low-yield legacy salvage pipeline.

limitations: This is an internal engineering pilot, not clinician review or clinical validation.
The audit used deterministic triage and targeted agent review; it was not a complete record-by-record evidence audit.

audit_sample.stop_rule: stopped after the keep bucket was shown unsafe and repair routing failures were confirmed
